name: PaperClean API
description:
Document image cleanup and enhancement API. PaperClean removes shadows, fixes contrast, corrects perspective, and produces clean, high-quality scans from photos of documents taken with any camera or phone.

Features:
- **2-pass enhancement** for superior quality (shadows removed, contrast optimized)
- **Perspective correction** with 4-corner coordinates
- **Configurable pipeline** (combine crop + enhance in one call)
- **Fast processing** powered by Rust backend
- **Multiple formats** supported: JPG, PNG, WebP, TIFF
